title: Performance Monitoring
definition: Monitoring involves tracking response times, memory usage, CPU spikes, and error rates in production. Tools like New Relic, Datadog, or Sentry integrate seamlessly with Express via middleware to provide real-time dashboards.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Performance Monitoring?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
